author: Maria Robinson
body: I originally bought the customized sleep plan when my daughter was 5mo old. We had been struggling with reflux, cosleeping, and it just wasn’t working for any of us. We were able to transition her from cosleeping, to sleeping 8-10hr stretches in her pack n play in our room in 3 nights. Four months later we were ready to transition her to her crib in her own room - our plan was able to help us once again. We still chose to rock her to sleep, but she was sleeping 12-13hr nights with no tears in her own room after 2 nights. This month we finally decided rocking her to sleep wasn’t working for us. Using our same plan, within 1wk our daughter (now 19mo) was falling asleep independently with no tears. All of this to say, this plan has helped us thru every sleep transition so far, as well as helping to navigate teething, sickness, travel, and figuring out how/when to drop naps. Forever grateful for Andrea’s plan and help in our sleep journey!
